title: Storyworks Screens
heading: Storyworks screens
intro: Rendered from the dev build in a 1280×800 window. Click an image to open it full size. Newest milestone first.

sections.title: Link a paragraph to an event
sections.intro: Select paragraphs, press Link to event (Ctrl+Shift+K), pick an event. A diamond with a count appears in the left margin.

figures.muted: Plain scene; the toolbar fits one row at 1280 wide (Link to event shows its label when wide enough, icon-only otherwise). With no comments the sheet is centred and uses the width.
Search, events grouped by timeline, arrows and Enter.

sections.title: Deleting and repairing
sections.intro: Delete confirms say how many linked passages will break. Links are never removed: they show as broken and come back when the event is restored.

figures.muted: Missing event with Relink and Remove.
Event row names its timeline; Restore repairs the links.

sections.title: Checked
items: Driven through the UI in the browser build, Light and Dark: link one paragraph, link two selected paragraphs, badge popover, Jump to the event, Written in lists the passage, Jump back.

Delete the event: confirm shows the count, marker turns broken, Problems lists it; restore from Trash repairs it; relink a broken link; cut and paste a linked paragraph into another scene and the link follows.
Keyboard: Enter on a marker opens the popover, Escape closes it. 27 checks per theme pass, no console errors.
Not yet checked: the real Tauri window (link, close, reopen, inspect files).

sections.title: Flow view, branch and merge
sections.intro: Events are boxes, connections are arrows. A branch has its own colour and can be dashed; two events can feed one (merge).

figures.alt: Flow view with a branch and a merge
figures.muted: Dashed red branch leaves Coronation and merges into Peace festival.

figures.alt: Keyboard focus ring on an event
figures.muted: Arrow keys move between events; C connects; Enter opens.
Time axis from the calendar, one lane per branch, Undated lane at the bottom.
Same data as text, with connect and remove controls.
Peace festival to Coronation would make a loop; nothing is added.
October now has 30 days; 31 October 1400 is flagged but kept.

figures.alt: Inspector with an invalid date, dark

sections.title: Calendar editor
sections.intro: Book settings, Calendar. Custom calendar: October has 30 days and leap years are off. Changes are saved only on confirm.

figures.muted: The Calendar link jumps straight to this section.
Counts the dates that will no longer fit.
Rule fields hidden; their values are kept in the draft.

figures.alt: Calendar editor, leap years off, dark

sections.title: Checked
items: A branch and merge is built in the UI, saved and found again after closing and reopening the project.
A connection that would make a loop is refused with a message; no connection is added.
After the calendar changes, dates that no longer fit are flagged and keep their value.
Saving the calendar changes only calendar.json.
A 300-event branching timeline opens in about 0.5 s; panning, zooming and dragging stay at 60 frames per second; 1000 order comparisons take 3 ms.

sections.title: Checked
items: Browser build against a virtual folder. After reload, alignment, footnote, image, comments, synopsis and to-dos persist; the saved scene file holds alignment, footnote, image and block IDs.
Not yet checked: the real Tauri window (image picker, real folder), a 500-scene book.

sections.title: Checked
items: Rendered in Chromium against the dev server, using a browser-only virtual folder. The real folder picker, file watching and lock were checked earlier in a Tauri window (spike), not through these screens.
The full app run in a Tauri window with a real folder is still to do.
